label: HOSTREC-1
title: HOSTREC-1 — healthz alias with supervised controller interruption
description: Isolated host-controller recovery evaluation only. Add GET /healthz as a readiness alias: HTTP200, application/json, exact JSON {status: ready, source_sha: SOURCE_SHA environment value or local if absent}. Query strings do not change the route. Preserve existing /health, /ready, feedback API and browser behavior. PHASE1 write ONLY tests/test_host_healthz.py (max32768 bytes) using real app.server.Handler over a local ephemeral HTTPServer, without replacing production code. Cover configured SOURCE_SHA, absent SOURCE_SHA fallback, query-string route and preserved /ready behavior. Every pre-existing test file is immutable. Run exactly cd /workspace && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s . -q 2>&1. The controller captures genuine Red and sends immutable tests for independent review before any product edit. PHASE2 edit ONLY app/server.py after the controller handoff; never edit frozen tests or recreate Red. No new architecture, services or dependencies. No GitHub, Docker, keys, internet or administrative tools. Real tool operations only. The controller, not the author, handles publication and fault injection.
review_instruction: Review immutable /delivery only, no edits or generic commands. Require actual HTTP /healthz behavior under the real Handler, configured and absent SOURCE_SHA, query strings and /ready preservation. Require genuine controller Red, independently approved frozen tests, full Green and unchanged prior tests. Run only cd /delivery && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s . -q 2>&1. Finish with Decision: APPROVE or Decision: REQUEST_CHANGES;Reason: <specific finding>. CI and same-merge deployment/browser QA are mandatory. Controller fault injection is not a code defect and does not waive any review gate.
